kind.ORDER_LATE_RISK: Orders at risk of being late
kind.MATERIAL_SHORT: Material short for released work orders
kind.INVOICE_DEADLINE: Shipped goods near their invoice deadline

when.ORDER_LATE_RISK: When an order is promised within {daysBeforePromise} and is not ready, or is late
when.HOLD_TOO_LONG: When goods are on hold longer than {hours}
when.MATERIAL_SHORT: When material is short for a released work order
when.APPROVAL_OVERDUE: When an approval waits longer than {hours}
when.PO_NOT_CONFIRMED: When a purchase order is not confirmed by the time the supplier was asked to answer by (none asked: {days} after it was sent)
when.INVOICE_DEADLINE: {daysBefore} before the deadline to invoice a DDT's goods

sentence.label: The rule as one sentence: change the parts in place

problem.failed: The rules could not be read. Try again.
problem.forbidden: You may not see these rules.
problem.gone: This rule is no longer there.
problem.offline: No answer from Nexus: check the connection and try again.

dialog.title: Rule: {kind}
dialog.builtIn: Built-in rule: it can be switched off, never removed.
dialog.offHint: Switched off, it raises nothing new; its open alerts stay for people to resolve, and a date rule's waiting timers are cancelled.
dialog.emailHint: E-mail is not sent at once: people get alerts by e-mail only in the daily digest they turn on in their notification preferences.
dialog.noKinds: There is nothing more a rule can watch here.

test.title: Try these numbers
test.foundAtLeast_one: Would find at least {count} record now
test.foundAtLeast_other: Would find at least {count} records now
test.fired_one: raised {count} alert in the last 7 days
test.fired_other: raised {count} alerts in the last 7 days
test.honest: Counted against the records as they are now: Nexus keeps no copy of how they were last week.
test.newRule: Counted against the records as they are now, with these numbers and this place.
test.noRuleOfKind: No rule of this kind is visible to test against yet.

timers.title: Timers
timers.none: No timer of this rule yet: the next check sets the ones it needs.

cancel.MOVED: The date it watches moved: a new timer was set.
cancel.GONE: The record no longer needs it.
cancel.RULE_CHANGED: The rule's numbers or place changed.

held.readOnly: You may see this rule but not change it: keeping rules needs the right to manage alert rules at its place.
held.offline: Offline — change it when back online.
held.choices: The places and roles are still being read.
held.noAdd: You may not add rules: keeping rules needs the right to manage alert rules.

refusal.noBell: An alert rule always tells through the bell: e-mail alone is not sent.
refusal.siteNeedsCompany: A site is named only with its company.
refusal.unchanged: Nothing to change: the rule is like that already.
refusal.changed: Someone changed this rule meanwhile: it was read again — make your change again.
refusal.numbers: The numbers are not valid for this rule.
refusal.place: That company or site is not there any more.
refusal.invalid: The rule was refused as it is.
refusal.forbidden: You may not keep the rules of that place.
refusal.gone: This rule is no longer there.
refusal.offline: No answer from Nexus: nothing was saved. Try again.
refusal.failed: The rule could not be saved. Try again.

notice.created: Rule added: the next check (within five minutes) applies it.
notice.switchedOff: Rule switched off: its open alerts stay for people to resolve.
